meta.title: Fix scroll wheel responsiveness in Windows App SDK by using system scroll settings
meta.body_summary: Make scroll wheel in Windows App SDK respect system 'lines per notch' setting and DPI by using SystemParametersInfo, fixing sluggish scrolling in React Native Windows.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented Windows system scroll-awareness but maintainer only requested process changes (change file, lint) and PR was closed without merge or performance validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2312 changed lines, this is a medium-to-large change by absolute volume, but most churn is in codegen files (2036 lines) and a change file; the core fix in ScrollViewComponentView.cpp is ~30 lines. Closed without merge, consistent with procedural hurdles and lack of maintainer approval.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer anupriya13 requested generating a change file, running lint:fix, and removing unnecessary codegen changes; Copilot addressed them, but PR eventually closed without performance-related review or approval.
review_details.performance_claim: Scroll wheel becomes more responsive by respecting Windows system scroll settings (lines per notch) and DPI scaling, replacing raw delta with system-aware calculation.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after ~33 days without maintainer approval; no performance or functional feedback from reviewers; only procedural interactions.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Integrating Windows-specific SystemParametersInfo API requires platform expertise; Copilot handled the API call, but process requirements (change file, lint rules) and inability to self-trigger CI exposed process boundaries.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code-reading review for performance; maintainer focused only on process requirements.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI pipelines were triggered by maintainer, but no performance-specific validation was performed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides numeric calculation scenarios but no before/after measurements or benchmark; maintainer did not test scroll behavior.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after ~33 days; no regression observed; procedural requests were addressed but no approval was given.

core_change_summary.description: In vnext/Microsoft.ReactNative/Fabric/Composition/ScrollViewComponentView.cpp, OnPointerWheelChanged now uses SystemParametersInfo to retrieve wheel scroll lines and calculates scroll delta based on notches, system lines, and pointScaleFactor; added helper GetSystemWheelScrollLines with error handling.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Codegen files had large churn (2036 lines in rnwcoreJSI.h) due to regeneration; change file is a standard project artifact.
